text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...Sorry to keep you waiting.
I'm done changing."

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
So... would it be alright
if I answered questions for now?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Yes! ...Allow me to say it once more,
thank you so much for today,
Believe-san, Trainer-san!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure the special program turns out wonderful.
So please, I'd greatly appreciate your cooperation!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I look forward to working with you.

On that day, Believe was being interviewed
for a TV special focusing on her...!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I see, so that is the mindset you bring to your daily training...
You are approaching this with truly steadfast determination.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Could you tell us more
about the grandfather you mentioned earlier?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
"...My grandfather.
He is the person I have always aspired to be like, and—"

Normally, Believe isn't the type to be very keen
on doing interviews like this.

"She gets done what needs to be done, but has no interest in standing out more than necessary...
That's just the kind of girl she is."
This time, however, the other party's enthusiasm was on a completely different level.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Phew... Did that running shot look okay?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
Yes! It truly was... the most incredible sight.
Thank you so much, Believe-san.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
...Truly, an unrivaled queen of the blitz.
How many times has my heart trembled watching you blaze past faster than anyone else?

text_block_list.name: Interviewer
text_block_list.text:
I'll make sure to create a program truly worthy of that legend.
...Thank you very much for your time today!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Yes. Thank you very much.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...Thank you for the meal.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(The dorm cafeteria is awfully empty today...
Usually it's way more lively around dinner time—)

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
O-Ouch... ?!
Believe-chan!!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: Huh? ...Dants-san?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Um, um... Sorry, I'll explain later!
It's about to start, so let's go...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: H-Huh? What do you mean "it's starting"—

text_block_list.name: Curren Chan
text_block_list.text:
Wah, the opening is so cool~~~!!
The lightning motif is a special privilege for us sprinters, after all♡

text_block_list.name: Aston Machan
text_block_list.text: Mmhmm. With this, Believe-san's charm will be a total electric shock-kaboom!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: When you said it's starting... did you mean this?

text_block_list.name: Dantsu Flame
text_block_list.text:
Huh!? O-Of course I am!
It's a special TV feature on Believe-chan, after all...!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (...To be honest, I'd largely forgotten about it, though.)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
(Or rather...
It feels like...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: There are so many... gathered here...

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text: Ahaha, well of course, Believe-senpai!!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Because you did something amazing, Senpai.
You tried and tried and tried your best,
and saw it all the way through!

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
"Seeing something through to the end...
People always say that's just common sense,
but honestly, it's crazy hard to do!"

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
Yet Senpai quietly does what needs to be done.
She handles the expected things as a matter of course.

text_block_list.name: Biko Pegasus
text_block_list.text:
That's an incredible thing.
In fact, it's the most amazing thing of all!

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
And so...
Yesterday ended up turning into quite a commotion.
choice_data_list: Sounds like it was a lively, wonderful night.
Sounds like it was a lively, wonderful night, huh?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
No, well...
Well, yeah.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text:
...Did you watch that TV show
yesterday too, Trainer?

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: ...I suppose that's true.

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Trainer's eyes...)

text_block_list.name: Believe
text_block_list.text: (Well, it is swollen like crazy...)
